description: Use this for a US company recent SEC 8-K filings, earnings-result disclosures, officer departures or material-event disclosures. Returns the 8-K and 8-K/A filings that the SEC lists for the company, read from SEC EDGAR, newest first over the last 365 days: filing items with titles, dates and original SEC links. This is not general stock news, article text, sentiment, analyst opinion or a complete filings archive. A filing item number alone does not state a conclusion.
name: get_company_disclosures
title: List company SEC filings
